placement.screenshot_legibility: visible probes are drawn with a deterministic stride when more than ~26000 are visible; all probes remain in the NPZ

xray.hidden_rule: on screen but view_z > primary depth + declared tolerance
xray.hidden_legibility: hidden probes are drawn 1:4 as 1px x; all hidden probes remain in the NPZ

sh_lobes.zero_clamp: evaluated SH response is clamped to >= 0 before colour/radius
sh_lobes.saturation: values above lobe_radiance_max saturate; no per-state or per-probe normalisation
sh_lobes.note: lobe endpoints are function samples projected around the recorded probe; they are not traced rays and are not geometry

fixed_scales.radiance_units: unit-albedo Lambertian outgoing radiance = e_normal_radiance/pi, scene-referred after /CachedLightingPreExposure
fixed_scales.zero_clamp: evaluated SH response is clamped to >= 0 before colour/radius
fixed_scales.saturation: values above lobe_radiance_max saturate; no per-state or per-probe normalisation
